items.distractor_fact: Термометърът в съседното село отчел {D} °C същата сутрин.
items.gloss_en: The thermometer in the neighboring village recorded {D} °C that same morning.
items.entity_note: Different owner: another village's thermometer, not the balcony thermometer in the story; the unit symbol °C never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Акциите на друга компания се търгували за {D} $ по същото време.
items.gloss_en: Another company's shares were trading at {D} $ at the same time.
items.entity_note: Different owner: a different company's stock, not the one in the story; the unit symbol $ never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Връхната точка на съседния хребет се издига на {D} м.
items.gloss_en: The peak of the neighboring ridge rises to {D} m.
items.entity_note: Different place: a neighboring ridge's summit elevation, not a point on the hiker's own route; the unit symbol м never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Друг спортист от лагера тежал {D} кг.

items.entity_note: Different owner: a different athlete's weight, not the athlete in the story; the unit symbol кг never inflects after a numeral.

items.gloss_en: Another customer of the bank had {D} € in his own account.
items.entity_note: Different owner: a different customer's account balance, not the client's account in the story; the unit symbol € never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: В друга спестовна сметка в банката били внесени {D} $ през годината.

items.entity_note: Different owner: deposits into a different savings account, not the one in the story; the unit symbol $ never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Друга фирма в същия квартал отчела приходи от {D} $ през месеца.
items.gloss_en: Another company in the same neighborhood recorded revenue of {D} $ during the month.
items.entity_note: Different owner: a different business's revenue, not the business in the story; the unit symbol $ never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Друг отбор от лигата вкарал {D} гола през сезона.
items.gloss_en: Another team in the league scored {D} goals during the season.
items.entity_note: Different owner: a different team's goals scored, not the team in the story; 'гола' is the invariant Bulgarian counting form after any numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Друг фонд управлявал портфейл, който отчел печалби от {D} $ през годината.
items.gloss_en: Another fund managed a portfolio that recorded gains of {D} $ during the year.
items.entity_note: Different owner: a different portfolio's gains, not the portfolio in the story; the unit symbol $ never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: Друг завод от същия холдинг произвел {D} бройки през месеца.
items.gloss_en: Another factory in the same holding produced {D} units during the month.
items.entity_note: Shared-reference domain: a different factory's own monthly output, whose own target is never stated, so it cannot be paired with the story's plan; 'бройки' is a feminine plural noun that keeps the same form after any numeral.

items.distractor_fact: На друг метеорологичен пост паднали {D} мм валежи през същата седмица.

items.entity_note: Shared-reference domain: a different station's own rainfall reading, whose own forecast is never stated, so it cannot be paired with the story's forecast; the unit symbol мм never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: На друго игрище друг голфър направил {D} удара за цялата обиколка.

items.distractor_fact: Друг влак по различна линия пристигнал {D} мин след тръгването си.
items.gloss_en: Another train, on a different line, arrived {D} min after its own departure.
items.entity_note: Shared-reference domain: a different train on a different line, whose own schedule is never stated, so it cannot be paired with the story's schedule; 'мин' never inflects after a numeral.

items.distractor_fact: В съседната сграда апартамент се намира на етаж с обозначение {D}.
items.gloss_en: In the neighboring building, an apartment is on the floor designated {D}.
items.entity_note: Shared-reference domain: a different building's own floor designation, whose own ground floor is never stated, so it cannot be paired with the story's ground floor; the bare numeral before 'с обозначение' stays grammatical for any integer.
